Ride-A-Bike Happy Tuesday Ride

Gastonia, NC · Downtown · Social

No-dropBeginner friendly

Ride-A-Bike Happy Tuesday Ride is a social group ride in Gastonia, NC. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:00 pm from Ride A Bike Bicycle Shop. About 9 miles, party pace, 6–9 mph. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 6–9 mph: you can talk the whole way. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @rideabikenc the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Ride-A-Bike Happy Tuesday Ride group ride

A slow social ride through quiet Gastonia neighborhoods. It leaves from the front of the shop. The group stops as needed to stay together. Helmets required. Call the shop or check its Facebook page for updates.
